name: The Knights of the Round Table
dom: chivalry; fellowship; defense of the realm; the Grail quest
note: The fellowship of knights sworn to Arthur, gathered about the Round Table at Camelot.

name: King Arthur
dom: kingship; war; the Round Table; the once and future king
note: Legendary king of the Britons who founds the Round Table at Camelot and is borne to Avalon after Camlann.

name: Guinevere
dom: queenship; courtly love; the affair with Lancelot
note: Wife of Arthur whose love for Lancelot precipitates the fall of the realm.

name: Uther Pendragon
dom: kingship; war; the begetting of Arthur
note: King who, disguised by Merlin as Gorlois, begets Arthur upon Igraine at Tintagel.

name: Igraine
dom: noble lineage; the begetting of Arthur
note: Wife of Gorlois then Uther; mother of Arthur, Morgan, and Morgause.

name: Mordred
dom: treachery; usurpation; the destruction of the realm
note: Begotten by Arthur upon Morgause; slays and is slain by Arthur at Camlann.

name: Morgan le Fay
dom: magic; healing; enmity toward the court
note: Magical half-sister of Arthur, both healer at Avalon and adversary of the court.

name: Morgause
dom: queenship; the begetting of Mordred; the Orkney lineage
note: Half-sister of Arthur, wife of Lot, mother of the Orkney knights and of Mordred.

name: King Lot
dom: kingship; war; the Orkney lineage
note: King of Orkney, husband of Morgause and father of Gawain and his brothers.

name: Merlin
dom: magic; prophecy; counsel; the founding of the realm
note: Prophet-magician who engineers Arthur's begetting and establishes the Round Table; in Robert de Boron, fathered by a devil and baptized.

name: The Lady of the Lake
dom: magic; the otherworld; the giving of Excalibur
note: Otherworldly enchantress (Nimue/Viviane) who gives Excalibur, fosters Lancelot, and enchants Merlin.

name: Lancelot
dom: chivalry; prowess; courtly love; the adultery with Guinevere
note: The foremost knight, whose love for Guinevere brings the realm to ruin.

name: Galahad
dom: perfect chastity; the Grail quest; holiness
note: Son of Lancelot and Elaine of Corbenic, the sinless knight who achieves the Grail.

name: Perceval
dom: the Grail quest; innocence; chivalric formation
note: The naive young knight (Parzival) who comes to the Grail castle; one of the Grail achievers.

name: Gawain
dom: chivalry; courtesy; kinship loyalty; the test of honor
note: Eldest son of Lot and Morgause and nephew of Arthur; tested by the Green Knight.

name: Bors
dom: chivalry; piety; the Grail quest
note: Cousin of Lancelot and the only Grail achiever to return to Camelot.

name: Tristan
dom: chivalry; the tragic love for Isolde
note: Cornish knight whose love for Isolde parallels the Lancelot-Guinevere affair.

name: Kay
dom: the seneschalship; blunt speech
note: Arthur's foster-brother and seneschal, brusque but loyal.

name: Bedivere
dom: loyalty; the return of Excalibur
note: Companion who casts Excalibur back into the lake at Arthur's end.

name: Gareth
dom: chivalry; the proving of worth; kinship
note: Brother of Gawain who proves his knighthood; slain inadvertently by Lancelot.

name: Gaheris
dom: kinship; the Orkney feud; vengeance
note: Brother of Gawain who slays Morgause; later killed by Lancelot.

name: Agravain
dom: kinship; intrigue; the exposure of the adultery
note: Brother of Gawain who with Mordred exposes the affair, triggering the collapse.

name: Lamorak
dom: prowess; the Pellinore-Orkney feud; courtly love
note: Son of Pellinore; his affair with Morgause leads to murder by the Orkney brothers.

name: Pellinore
dom: kingship; the Questing Beast; the feud
note: King who pursues the Questing Beast, slays Lot, and fathers Lamorak.

name: The Green Knight
dom: the beheading game; the test of honor; the otherworld
note: Green otherworldly challenger (Bertilak enchanted) who tests Gawain's honor in the beheading game.

name: The Fisher King
dom: guardianship of the Grail; the wasteland and its healing
note: Maimed guardian of the Grail (Pelles/Anfortas) whose wound mirrors the wasteland.

name: Elaine of Corbenic
dom: the Grail lineage; the conception of Galahad
note: Daughter of Pelles who conceives Galahad with Lancelot to fulfill prophecy.

name: Isolde
dom: tragic love; the love potion; courtly devotion
note: Irish princess and queen of Cornwall, fated lover of Tristan.

name: Elaine of Astolat
dom: unrequited love; tragic death
note: The lily maid of Astolat who dies of unrequited love for Lancelot.

name: The Holy Grail
dom: divine grace; revelation; healing; the Eucharist
note: The vessel of the Last Supper brought to Britain by Joseph of Arimathea; object of the great quest.

name: Excalibur
dom: kingship; war; sovereignty; the otherworld
note: Arthur's sword (Geoffrey's Caliburn), given by the Lady of the Lake and returned to her at his death.

name: The Round Table
dom: fellowship; equality of the knights; the chivalric order
note: The round table made by Merlin so that no knight should sit above another.

name: Avalon
dom: the otherworld; healing; the resting place of Arthur
note: Otherworldly isle where Excalibur was forged and to which Arthur is borne to be healed.

name: Camelot
dom: kingship; the chivalric court; the seat of the Round Table
note: The principal seat of Arthur's court and of the Round Table.

name: The Siege Perilous
dom: the Grail destiny; sanctity; predestination
note: The empty seat, fatal to the unworthy, reserved for the Grail knight Galahad.
